verdict.rationale: A public status page with incident history is a fair question for a hosted inference platform like Replicate, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack mentions a status page or incident history. Built-in metrics and logs [replicate-docs-8] are a different, adjacent feature: they monitor a user's own model, not platform uptime.

support.subject: As a founder, I can check a public status page with incident history before betting production traffic on the platform
